fui_quests_after_match: Progress counts when the match ends.
fui_q_positive_kd: Finish with more kills than deaths: %1
fui_quests_reroll_hint: You can swap one quest a day

fui_err_quest_rerolls: You can swap a quest once a day.
fui_err_quest_done: A finished quest can't be swapped.
fui_classdesc_scout: The fastest on the field. Double jump, captures points twice as fast.
fui_classdesc_soldier: Rocket launcher and rocket jumps. Takes a beating, hits an area.
fui_classdesc_pyro: Flamethrower and compressed air: reflects projectiles, keeps people away.
fui_classdesc_demoman: Grenades and stickies. Locks down chokes and wrecks buildings.
fui_classdesc_heavy: The most health and a minigun that does not stop.
fui_classdesc_engineer: Sentries, dispensers and teleporters. Holds ground while the nest stands.
fui_classdesc_medic: Heals and builds ÜberCharge. The whole team wins around a Medic.
fui_classdesc_sniper: Kills with one headshot from across the map.
fui_classdesc_spy: Invisibility, disguises and a knife in the back.
fui_war_no_ops: The front is quiet right now.

fui_set_workshop_d: Your maps and items on Steam Workshop
